salud-mental.title: Mental Health
salud-mental.description: Evaluate your emotional state and detect signs of stress, anxiety, or depression.
salud-mental.introText: This section contains questionnaires to understand how your mental health manifests in daily life and help guide the necessary support.
salud-mental.instructions: Answer each question based on how you have been feeling recently.

0.title: Psychiatric Symptomatology
0.description: Mental health is a state of well-being that allows you to cope with the stress of life. But if there is an imbalance, it needs attention. Here you will find questionnaires that will help you know about your mental health and recommendations on what to do.

1.title: Eating Behavior
1.description: The foods we consume help our physical health, provide energy for good functioning, but can also affect our mental health. We ask you to answer the following questionnaire, which will help you know if your eating habits are healthy.

2.title: Traumatic Events
2.description: We have all experienced some trauma or event that has affected us. This questionnaire will help us see if these were significant in your mental health.

3.title: Global Functioning
3.description: This scale evaluates the global functioning present in your life, how functional you are across various aspects of your life.

4.title: Resilience
4.description: Resilience is the ability to adapt to adverse situations. In this questionnaire you will find questions that describe situations you have experienced and how you solved them.

5.title: Tobacco
5.description: This scale evaluates your relationship with excessive tobacco use, nicotine, and whether you have problems due to addiction caused by its active component. Its use affects the central nervous system, increasing dopamine levels, reinforcing the behavior of continued use, and creating addiction.

6.title: Alcohol
6.description: This questionnaire is designed around alcohol consumption and will help us evaluate you. It will also help identify if you need additional support. Your responses will provide valuable information to understand your drinking habits or if you have problems with alcohol consumption.

salud-fisica.title: Physical Health
salud-fisica.description: Record your activity, sleep, and habits to understand your overall health.
salud-fisica.introText: In this section you will answer questionnaires related to your physical health, activity, and rest to see how they relate to your overall well-being.
salud-fisica.instructions: Answer each question honestly to evaluate your integrated physical health.

0.title: General State
0.description: This questionnaire is designed to evaluate your current level of physical activity and help you understand how your exercise habits affect your health and well-being. It is also important for keeping your mental health balanced.

1.title: Sleep Quality
1.description: This questionnaire is designed to evaluate how you sleep and help you identify factors that may be affecting your rest. Your responses will allow us to offer recommendations to improve your sleep quality and overall well-being.

2.title: Physical Activity
2.description: This questionnaire is designed to evaluate your current level of physical activity and help you understand how your exercise habits affect your health and well-being. It is also important for keeping your mental health balanced.

3.title: Global Health
3.description: This questionnaire is designed to evaluate your physical and mental well-being overall. Through your responses, we can better understand your health status and explore possible areas to improve your quality of life.

determinantes-sociales.instructions: Answer each question considering your social environment and living conditions.

consent.title: Informed Consent
consent.subtitle: Study title: Mental Health and Addictions

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: You are invited to participate in our ADDICTIONS project, whose purpose is to evaluate and monitor the mental health of students in Mexico. Your participation will help identify risk factors and offer support interventions according to your level of need.

sections.title: Objective
paragraphs: To detect symptoms of depression, anxiety, substance use, eating disorders, and suicide risk in a timely manner through validated electronic questionnaires and an automated risk classification system.

sections.title: Procedures
items: You will access an electronic link where this informed consent will be presented to you.
If you accept, you will complete a sociodemographic questionnaire and then answer the clinical scales: PHQ-9, GAD-7, C-SSRS, ASSIST v3, S-EDE, and Screener questionnaire.

sections.title: Duration
items: Answering the questionnaires takes approximately 30 to 40 minutes.
The same procedure will be repeated after 6 months to monitor your progress.

sections.title: Benefits

items.text: you will receive a digital preventive kit with practical resources to strengthen your self-care and well-being during your medical training.

you will receive personalized feedback about your mental health and will be offered free interventions, differentiated according to your level of risk (group workshops, brief psychotherapy, referral to specialized services, or emergency protocols).

items: Your participation will contribute to generating evidence to improve mental health programs.

sections.title: Risks
items: Some questions may cause emotional discomfort; you may skip any question you do not wish to answer.

In the event of high or imminent risk, the teaching department and/or mental health services will be notified immediately, only in accordance with the authorization you granted in this consent, for the exclusive purpose of activating support and protection measures for your health and well-being.

sections.title: Confidentiality
items: Your personal data will be processed in accordance with the General Law for the Protection of Personal Data Held by Obligated Parties and the Federal Law for the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties.
The information will be stored on a secure electronic platform, with access restricted only to the authorized research team.
Your results will only be used for the purposes of this study and will not be disclosed in a way that allows you to be identified.
If high or imminent risk is detected, your information may be shared exclusively with the teaching department and mental health services in your state, only to activate clinical support protocols.
You may contact the mental health team administering the questionnaires, who will serve as the first support and follow-up contact in your state.

sections.title: Voluntary participation
paragraphs: Your participation is free and voluntary. You may decide not to participate or withdraw at any time.

sections.title: Note on biological samples
items: This consent applies only to the clinical portion (questionnaires and follow-up).

If you agree to donate a blood sample or cheek swab, you will receive a separate consent form prepared by the National Institute of Genomic Medicine (INMEGEN), which is responsible for the genetic portion.

authorization.label: I AUTHORIZE
authorization.disclaimer: In the event of high or imminent risk, both the teaching department and mental health services in my state may be notified in order to activate support protocols.
authorization.warning: Important note: To complete registration, you must accept the terms and conditions.
authorization.warningSecondary: Otherwise, the account will not be registered.
